mapper.insert: insert into vm_air_map_annotation_t (type, geometry, properties, create_time, create_user, delete_flag, industry_code, annotation_Name, tenant_id) values (#{type}, #{geometry}, #{properties}, NOW(), #{createUser}, 0, #{industryCode}, CONCAT(#{annotationName}, (SELECT count FROM (SELECT COUNT(id)+1 AS count FROM vm_air_map_annotation_t WHERE type = #{type} ${dataScope} ) AS temp)), #{tenantId})
mapper.select: select id, type, geometry, properties, create_time as createTime, create_user as createUser, industry_code as industryCode, annotation_Name as annotationName from vm_air_map_annotation_t where annotation_Name = #{annotationName} and delete_flag = 0 ${dataScope}

select id, type, geometry, properties, create_time as createTime, create_user as createUser, industry_code as industryCode, annotation_Name as annotationName from vm_air_map_annotation_t where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into vm_air_map_area_t (type, fly_type, geometry, properties, create_time, create_user, delete_flag, industry_code, area_name, tenant_id, status, device_codes) values (#{type},#{flyType}, #{geometry}, #{properties}, NOW(), #{createUser}, 0, #{industryCode}, #{flyName}, #{tenantId} ,'1', #{deviceCodesStr})
mapper.select:
select id, type, fly_type as flyType, geometry, status, properties, create_time as createTime, create_user as createUser, industry_code as industryCode, area_name as flyName, device_codes as deviceCodesStr from vm_air_map_area_t t LEFT JOIN ( WITH recursive cte AS ( SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM cte WHERE n < 50 ) SELECT id AS area_id, substring_index( substring_index( t2.device_codes, ',', cte.n ), ',', - 1 ) AS device_code FROM vm_air_map_area_t t2 JOIN cte ON cte.n <= ( length( t2.device_codes ) - length( REPLACE ( t2.device_codes, ',', '' )) + 1 ) WHERE t2.delete_flag = 0 AND t2.device_codes IS NOT NULL ) split_device ON t.id = split_device.area_id where t.delete_flag = 0
and t.area_name like CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{queryName}), '%')
and t.fly_type = #{flyType}
and (split_device.device_code in
#{item}
or t.device_codes is null)
${dataScope} order by t.create_time desc

select id, type, fly_type as flyType, geometry, status, properties, create_time as createTime, create_user as createUser, industry_code as industryCode, area_name as flyName, device_codes as deviceCodesStr from vm_air_map_area_t where delete_flag = 0 and id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vm_air_map_point_t ( point_name, longitude, latitude, industry_code, create_time, create_user, delete_flag, device_code, uav_code, task_record_id, task_record_name, uav_name, photo_id, time_created, photo_url, task_access_node, tenant_id, app_ver_code, photo_json_info, photo_height, point_type, status ) VALUES ( #{pointName}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{industryCode}, now(), #{createUser}, 0, #{deviceCode}, #{uavCode}, #{taskRecordId}, #{taskRecordName}, #{uavName}, #{photoId}, #{timeCreated}, #{photoUrl}, #{photoAccessNode}, #{tenantId}, #{appVerCode}, #{photoJsonInfo}, #{photoHeight}, #{pointType}, 1 )

insert into vm_air_line_col_t (collect_id, user_id, create_time, create_user, col_type, longitude, latitude,url,device_Code,medium_create_time,industry_code,collect_name) values (#{photoId}, #{userId}, now(), #{userId}, #{collectType}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{url}, #{deviceCode},#{timeCreated},#{industryCode},#{photoName})
